author: @mooscuue
text:
"How many more Black Features till you're black enough?" Is still such a crazy bar, because it refers to a myriad of things depending on the listeners interpretation and ALL of them are correct. 

Black Features as in how he he's only half, and so removed from black culture that he tries to emulate black American culture to fit in.

Black Features being obvious with skin tone, nose, full lips and other obvious physical traits that are common with black folks.

Black Features meaning artists who were in already credible within the music scene and that he connected with and used to make himself ALSO seem credible. 

It may not also be a stretch to say Black Features as in TV or Movies because Drake was on Degrassi. 

Kendrick genuinely broke this man down to his core in this song and it's still probably my favorite from the beef aside from Not Like Us which is more like a Victory Lap and Meet the Grahams which is just malicious all around. Kendrick really is the boogeyman 😭😭😭😭
